turns.q: Can I pay in installments or split payment?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: **Installment & Split Payment Options** - Faherty Brand offers Klarna for online purchases, which lets you split your payment into four interest-free installments. Just select Klarna at checkout and follow the instructions. - Other payment methods accepted: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, PayPal, Shopify Pay, and Amazon Pay. **Next Steps** - If you want to use Klarna, simply choose it at checkout. You’ll pay in four equal payments, every two weeks.
